epics.title: Platform Foundation
epics.summary: Establish runtime, local development, infrastructure skeleton, and CI/CD baseline required for all subsequent implementation.
outcomes: Developers and agents can run app+api locally with deterministic tooling.
QA/prod infrastructure wrappers are present and validated through Terraform plan.
CI checks and deployment triggers are operational and enforce merge gates.

epics.title: Auth, ACL, Core Entities
epics.summary: Implement identity, sessions, authorization, core domain persistence, and setup creation flows.
outcomes: Social and magic-link sign-in are functional with secure cookie sessions.
League creator receives admin access and ACL is enforced for write operations.
Leagues, seasons, sessions, and games can be created end-to-end from API and UI.

epics.title: Live Match Operations
epics.summary: Deliver the phone-first live game workflow: rostering, timer/third control, scoring events, timeline edits, and game completion.
outcomes: Scorekeeper can manage teams/players and log goals quickly while match is in progress.
Goal validation enforces agreed own-goal and assist rules, including any-team assists up to 3.
Game finish computes deterministic result with immutable locked state and audit trail.

epics.title: Public Results and Season Stats
epics.milestone: M3 Public Results and Season Stats
epics.summary: Publish game and season outcomes publicly while preserving privacy boundaries and claimable player identities.
outcomes: Public game URLs resolve by slug/id and render canonical results and timeline.
Season standings and leaderboards are computed with deterministic ranking comparator.
Claim flow links user identity to quick-created players with conflict-safe behavior.

epics.title: Notifications and Product Polish
epics.summary: Add asynchronous notifications, improve join UX, and complete observability and security hardening for production readiness.
outcomes: Game finish triggers reliable email jobs with retries and visibility.
Players receive personalized email summaries and links to game outcomes.
Operational dashboards/alerts and final security controls are in place.

epics.title: Risk-Based Pull Request Review System
epics.summary: Prepare pull requests for focused human judgement with deterministic risk, evidence, review-state, and architecture controls.
outcomes: Every pull request presents one behavioural claim and risk-proportionate evidence.
A stable review-gate reports current automated, Codex, discussion, and approval state.
Review enforcement is introduced only after observe-mode results and independent reviewer availability support it.

epics.title: Mobile-First Frontend Redesign
epics.summary: Deliver the approved frontend-first design and language refinements as a bottom-up reviewed PR stack. Sign-out M1-13 is a linked dependency; new player/public/performance work remains deferred.
outcomes: Existing organiser, game, roster, scoring, result and entry journeys are readable, human and phone-first.
Distinct overlapping actors retain correct access, working mutations and truthful recovery.
Each PR reaches current-head Codex/CI/QA/review-gate readiness with evidence for AJ, without merge/release.

epics.title: Reusable players and profile linking
epics.summary: Create a player once, reuse across games, and link their account later. Depends on activated M3-07 ownership proof; no automatic name matching or cross-league discovery.
outcomes: Season/league search reuses claimed and unclaimed identities.
Directed private invitations safely connect existing accounts to exact profiles.
League-only reviewed duplicate consolidation preserves historical IDs and scoring.
Returning players reuse owned league identities; migration and rollback evidence precede enablement.
